controles.affirmation: Sur l'exercice 2024, le resultat operationnel du segment Underground and Infrastructure a chute de 29,9 % et sa marge est tombee de 7,5 % a 5,7 %, et le 10-K citait des surcouts sur deux projets solaires americains.
controles.verbatim_source: Underground and Infrastructure Segment Results. Operating Income. The decrease in operating income and operating margin for the year ended December 31, 2024 was primarily due to decreased revenues and overall mix of work performed during the period, which contributed to lower levels of fixed cost absorption, and an $11.9 million loss recorded during the year ended December 31, 2024 related to the disposition of a non-core business. || Electric Segment Results. Operating Income. The increase in operating income and operating margin for the year ended December 31, 2024 was primarily due to the increase in revenues and change in the overall mix of work, including an increase in higher margin emergency restoration services. The increase in operating margin was also impacted by improved performance on transmission and generation projects, partially offset by increased costs on two solar projects in the United States.
controles.correction_proposee: Les chiffres (-29,9 %, marge de 7,5 % a 5,7 %) sont exacts, mais la cause invoquee est celle d'un autre segment. Les surcouts sur deux projets solaires americains sont cites dans la discussion du segment Electric, dont la marge AUGMENTE en 2024 ; ils ne sont pas la cause du recul d'Underground and Infrastructure. Formulation correcte : "la baisse est attribuee par le 10-K a des revenus en repli, un mix de travaux moins favorable, une moindre absorption des couts fixes et une perte de 11,9 M$ liee a la cession d'une activite non strategique ; les surcouts sur deux projets solaires americains concernent, eux, le segment Electric."
